title: Lock-free migrations: db_constraint=False FKs and constant db_default columns; schema PR lands before code
answers: How to create a table with FKs to posthog_team without locking
How to add a column to an existing table without a rewrite
Why is retention_days defined with default and db_default?
body:
Convention in tracing migrations (0006, 0007):
- New tables FK to `posthog.Team`/`posthog.User` use `db_constraint=False` (with `related_name="+"`), so CREATE TABLE takes no lock on the parents; cascade/set-null are enforced by the Django collector only.
- New columns on existing tables use a constant `default=` plus `db_default=Value(...)` (products/tracing/backend/models.py:TeamTracingConfig.retention_days) so no table rewrite.
- Schema-only migrations are split into their own PR ahead of dependent code; update products/tracing/backend/migrations/max_migration.txt with the latest migration.
- Mirrored constants that can't be imported across products (DEFAULT_TRACES_RETENTION_DAYS vs logs) are duplicated and pinned by a test (products/tracing/backend/tests/test_models.py).
applies: Migrations for PostHog product apps, esp. tracing/logs.
